date_from.description: Earliest bucket start in the range. A relative date such as `-30d`, or an ISO 8601 date.

date_to.description: Latest bucket start in the range. A relative date or an ISO 8601 date. Defaults to now.

include_buckets.description: Return the buckets of each series. Set false for the per-series summary only.

include_warmup.description: Include warm-up buckets: scored rows with a null score and flag, written while the detector still lacks history. When false, a warm-up bucket shows as `scored: false`.

series_key.description: Only this series, by the `series_key` of an anomaly search row.
